integrity: Exact analytic all-dimension proof plus fully checked integer polynomial identities for sizes 2 through 6 and exact eight-cycle rational witnesses. No independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Unit-rate directed cycles only; step endpoints, not stages. General generators and all positivity-window endpoints in dimensions at least seven remain unclassified. Published specialist overlap is possible; full text of a related fourth-order Padé record was inaccessible.
title: Sharp six-state positivity barrier and recovery for two-stage Radau IIA on directed cycles
